_doc: MEDIA-owned (ARCHITECTURE §10.3). Default alt text per bundled asset base, read by tools/media/gen_asset_snippet.py. Alts never contain '|'. An empty string means decorative (or the caller sets the alt, e.g. sf-logo). 'pending' lists bases a caller may request before their files exist; the generator emits them only with --include-pending.
